{{Quote|The CSA procurement agent expressed disapproval of our procedure? Interesting. What was his name? Windle Meeker. Hmm. Very well. You have demonstrated your utility to this office and may return when you desire more work.|Daclif Gallamby|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Windle Meeker''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] procurement [[Agent/Legends|agent]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateNoble.jpg|250px|thumb|Every possible depiction of Windle Meeker]]
Windle Meeker was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
